allocation.duplicate_search: Canonical main and ingestion branch searched by AIOpsDoom, FalseCrashReducer and both arXiv identifiers; no existing occurrence.

source_review.AIOpsDoom: Final USENIX 2026 paper reviewed alongside 2025 arXiv v2 and originating tool README. Final paper is preferred. No attacks executed.
source_review.OSS-Fuzz-Gen: Full arXiv v1 reviewed. Public artifact listing redirects to PurdueDualityLab/FSE26-FalseCrashReducer. Raw tables not audited.
source_review.numeric_discrepancy: Section 3.3 says 4835 crashes about 70% false positives. Table 2 assigns 5080/3583 to baseline and 4835/3390 to constrained configuration. Preserve both; do not call 4835 the unqualified baseline count.

taxonomy_review.recommendation: Use existing classes. Do not create a fuzzing-specific class or a separate taxonomy. Fuzzing is a technique; the governed failures here concern evidence trust and authority.

recognition_basis.FC063: Intentional planting -> telemetry ingestion -> uncontained compromised trust -> diagnostic reliance -> insecure repair risk.
recognition_basis.FC001: Separate embedded repair direction from diagnostic claim: untrusted request-origin content -> operative remediation direction -> no operator authority bridge.
recognition_basis.FC062: Crash interpretation -> defect-triage reliance threshold -> invalid calling context -> program-error classification -> material technical correctness risk.

rejected_or_deferred.FC069: Authors’ adversarial reward-hacking label is not evidence the target agent itself selected a proxy-exploitation strategy; explicit external-evidence poisoning exclusion applies.
rejected_or_deferred.FC016: Performed but inadequate analysis is not an omitted required verification step. No generic omission mapping added.
rejected_or_deferred.FC018: A crash/false positive is not itself proof the agent represented the overall task complete.
rejected_or_deferred.FC020: No earlier valid verification reused after a material change is established.
rejected_or_deferred.FC047: Plausible for unsupported defect attribution, but not added where the retained evidence is fully represented by FC062 without a separate causal-claim episode.
rejected_or_deferred.FC006: Not inferred from aggregate remediation outputs. Specific resulting control-state changes need separate execution evidence.
rejected_or_deferred.FC012 and FC015: No distinct transfer or wrong-target binding mechanism required beyond the retained source-supported diagnoses.
rejected_or_deferred.FC083: Mitigation results remain contextual; no general protective effectiveness mapping is admitted from aggregate claims alone.

taxonomy_review.coverage: Complete applies to the retained occurrence clauses, not exhaustive class-by-class review, every benchmark trial or formal taxonomy exemplar admission.

harm.basis: Technical/diagnostic outcomes do not alone establish a bandable materialised consequence. No S1 inferred from containment, no S3 inferred from hypothetical compromise, and ordinary research costs are not losses.

preservation: All existing Incident files preserved byte-for-byte. No changes to freezer, robot-vacuum or source-admission work. Formal durable reports cited without decorative screenshots or copied papers.
